transport: none of the four — proprietary 7-pin control connector, not a documented dry contact · open-circuit voltage: ? · contact current: ? · cable `STCORD25 25' Generator Control Cable: 7 Pin ST Outlet Connector` (p.15); no pinout, voltage, fusing or crank-retry figures anywhere in either manual.

models.name: WGen12000DF
models.notes: "Smart Switch Outlet: Connects the Westinghouse ST Switch" (p.10)

gotchas: The cable also back-feeds the battery: "The generators battery is charged by this cable when the ST Switch is being powered by utility" (p.9) — so it carries power, not just a signal; do not treat it as two wires.

Required state: "Switch the generator engine control switch to RUN and confirm the battery indicator light illuminates" (p.11); ST Switch starts the set "5-10 seconds after utility loss" and allows "45-50 seconds to cool down before shutting it off" (p.12).
"Never use longer than 50ft total of generator control or power cables" (p.15). Storage 50–95 °F only.
No document reverse-engineers the 7 pins; wiring a relay to it is `?` on every figure.
